title: Match eliminates the role of COO, putting Hesam Hosseini out of a job after 18 years with the dating app giant, as part of changes under CEO Spencer Rascoff (Sarah Perez/TechCrunch)
summary: Sarah Perez / TechCrunch: Match eliminates the role of COO, putting Hesam Hosseini out of a job after 18 years with the dating app giant, as part of changes under CEO Spencer Rascoff — Tinder-owner Match Group announced on Thursday that it will eliminate the role of Chief Operating Officer (COO) …
